description: This file defines the OBBject class, a generic data container with methods for converting results to DataFrame, Polars, NumPy, and dictionary formats, as well as displaying charts and creating instances from queries. It is part of the openbb_core project and interacts with various abstract models and data handling libraries.

classes.name: OBBject
classes.description: A generic container class for results with methods for data conversion, visualization, and instantiation from queries.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string representation of the object.

methods.name: to_df
methods.description: Alias for to_dataframe, returns a pandas DataFrame with optional sorting and indexing.

methods.name: to_dataframe
methods.description: Converts the results attribute to a pandas DataFrame, handling various data formats and errors.

methods.name: to_polars
methods.description: Converts the DataFrame to a Polars DataFrame.

methods.name: to_numpy
methods.description: Converts the DataFrame to a NumPy array.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Converts the DataFrame to a dictionary with various orientation options.

methods.name: to_llm
methods.description: Converts the DataFrame to a JSON string suitable for LLM consumption.

methods.name: from_query
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an OBBject instance from a Query object.
